        work_dir = src_file.parent

        work_dir = proj

    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(

    try:
        cp = subprocess.run(

            cwd=proj,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,

    decl_line = (text or "").count("\n", 0, (text or "").find(HB_MARKER)) + 1
    out = cp.stdout + cp.stderr
    errors = [

        ok=(hb is not None and not errors),
